The decisive mistake was Statistics_Expert's proposal at step 6 to generate a mock dataset with a random 50% chance of snow. The mock data replaced the real historical data the task needed. It produced a meaningless 60% figure, which then led the team toward giving up (Validation_Expert's step 8 ended without any real data, and HistoricalWeatherData_Expert's step 9 terminated) instead of obtaining actual NOAA records, which would give the correct 30%.
